title: Afterschool Academic Support
description: We assist learners with homework, reading, and exam preparation in a safe learning environment. Our goal is to help every child improve academically and build confidence.

title: Community Feeding Scheme
description: We provide warm meals and food parcels to children and vulnerable families within the community.

title: Bible Study & Spiritual Guidance
description: Weekly Bible studies help young people grow in faith, character, and purpose.

title: Youth Job Assistance & CV Support
description: We help young people prepare CVs, improve interview skills, and access employment opportunities.

title: Community Outreach Programmes
description: We organise outreach events that provide food, clothing, and encouragement to families in need.

title: Youth Mentorship & Motivation
description: We mentor young people facing social challenges and encourage positive life choices.
